dedupe_keys.name: public infobanjir river water levels malaysia

description: Malaysia's Department of Irrigation and Drainage produced Public InfoBanjir, the official flood information site, whose water level page lists station readings by state with the time of each state's last update. Coverage is Malaysia's states and the federal territories of Kuala Lumpur, Labuan and Putrajaya, and the site belongs to the ministry for energy transition and water transformation. The readings are free to view online. Caveats: some states showed no recent data when read, the page offers no download or archive, and the footer reserves all rights. Simulation uses: current river levels for flood warning and emergency response. Related records: Malaysia's water supply statistics (data-malaysia-opendosm-water-supply-statistics).
